title: Correlation-Aware Contextual Bandits with Surrogate Rewards for LLM Routing
abstract: arXiv:2607.09015v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study contextual bandit problems with correlated arms and access to surrogate reward signals produced by a machine learning model, motivated by applications such as large language model (LLM) routing. Unlike classical contextual bandits that rely solely on bandit feedback and assume conditional independence across arms, our setting allows context-dependent inter-arm correlations and auxiliary reward information that may be noisy or misspecified. We propose algorithms that leverage such surrogate rewards through two complementary designs. A coupled reward-mixing approach pools true and surrogate rewards to accelerate learning when surrogate signals are reliable, while a decoupled prediction-mixing approach maintains separate estimators for bandit feedback and surrogate rewards and adaptively combines their predictions. This decoupling yields robustness to surrogate misspecification, recovering regret guarantees comparable to reward

translated_title: 面向大语言模型路由的具有代理奖励的相关性感知上下文多臂老虎机
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有相关臂并可获得由机器学习模型产生的代理奖励信号的上下文多臂老虎机问题，其动机来自大语言模型（LLM）路由等应用。与经典上下文多臂老虎机仅依赖老虎机反馈并假设臂间条件独立不同，我们的设定允许依赖上下文的臂间相关性，以及可能存在噪声或错误设定的辅助奖励信息。我们提出了通过两种互补设计来利用此类代理奖励的算法。一种耦合的奖励混合方法将真实奖励与代理奖励汇集在一起，在代理信号可靠时加速学习；而一种解耦的预测混合方法则为老虎机反馈和代理奖励分别维护独立的估计器，并自适应地组合它们的预测。这种解耦带来了对代理错误设定的鲁棒性，能够恢复与仅使用真实奖励相当的后悔保证。
tldr: 该论文提出了面向大语言模型路由的相关性感知上下文多臂老虎机算法，通过耦合奖励混合与解耦预测混合两种互补设计利用可能不可靠的代理奖励信号，在加速学习的同时对代理信号错误设定保持鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes correlation-aware contextual bandit algorithms for LLM routing that leverage potentially unreliable surrogate rewards through two complementary designs—coupled reward-mixing and decoupled prediction-mixing—accelerating learning while remaining robust to surrogate misspecification.
